notes.text:
This update for busybox fixes the following issues:

Security issues:

- CVE-2025-46394: Fixed tar hidden files via escape sequence (CVE-2025-46394, bsc#1241661)
- CVE-2025-60876: Fixed HTTP request header injection in wget (CVE-2025-60876, bsc#1253245)

Other issues:

- Set CONFIG_FIRST_SYSTEM_ID to 201 to avoid confclict (bsc#1236670)
- Fixed unshare -mrpf sh core dump on ppc64le (bsc#1249237)

notes.text: BusyBox wget thru 1.3.7 accepted raw CR (0x0D)/LF (0x0A) and other C0 control bytes in the HTTP request-target (path/query), allowing the request line to be split and attacker-controlled headers to be injected. To preserve the HTTP/1.1 request-line shape METHOD SP request-target SP HTTP/1.1, a raw space (0x20) in the request-target must also be rejected (clients should use %20).
